name: Tenpura! -Momiji Oroshi-
source:
A guy named Akatsuki meets a girl tengu in the mountains.
He's the first human she's ever seen, and has one request: to experience love.

Unfortunately, Akatsuki is kind of a bastard.

He uses her curiosity of love to make her have all kinds of sex.
They do it in the mountains, then he brings her home so he can fuck her every day with a bukkake creampie.

一個名叫曉的男人在山中遇見了一名天狗少女。
他是她見過的第一個人類，而她只有一個願望：體驗愛情。

遺憾的是，曉是個混蛋。

他利用天狗少女對愛情的好奇，讓她與自己進行各種性行為。
